description: Enjoy extra lives and player revival in your hardcore adventure!
body:
# RevivePlus

Enjoy extra lives and player revival in your hardcore adventure

## Feature List
- ❤️ Structure-based Ritualistic Revives ❤️
- 👻 Custom `/ghostmode` for Spectators 👻
- 👀 Dynamic `/deathlist` of Coordinates 👀
- 🤝 Social `/trust` List 🤝v
- 🔌 Highly Configurable 🔌
- 🌐 Yaml Language Support 🌐
